integrity: The exact polynomial identities are independently reproduced by the embedded standard-library checker. Numerical quadrature is diagnostic only. First-order persistence follows by a standard transverse-crossing implicit-function argument; historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Counts only simple zeros of the first-order radial return displacement in transverse-crossing annuli, not all limit cycles at fixed perturbation size. At the discriminant threshold the Melnikov root is double and no persistence claim is made. Grazing/sliding and higher-order degenerate cycles are outside scope.
title: Sharp degree-zero first-order cyclicity for two external switching circles
